_comment: Phase B (gap-filler/tutor) source whitelist. Versioned in the repo, editable without code changes. Planning artifact — no code reads this yet. Domains are matched against the hostname of a source URL; 'docs.*' is a pattern, see tier1_patterns.

rules.non_whitelisted_sources: allowed, but any draft citing one is flagged for extra review — never silently trusted
rules.below_minimum: draft is flagged, not rejected — the human approval step sees the flag

tier1_patterns.label: Official tool/framework documentation
tier1_patterns.note: Matches documentation subdomains (e.g. docs.python.org, docs.github.com). Intent: a tool's own official docs are Tier 1 for claims about that tool only.
